assign.request: the devbar needs to get farther off screen, the resize handle appears and hijacks user input
assign.now: measured in the live tab — closed rail is off screen but .dev-grip straddles its edge, leaving 15px of ew-resize strip over the page
steps: Reproduce and measure the overhang in the live tab
Push the closed transform past the grip in devbar.css
Verify closed: nothing on screen, right-edge clicks reach the page
Verify open: slide, hover pill and drag-resize still work
Refresh the doc set for anything gone stale

log.msg: Cause: `.dev-bar` hides with translateX(100%) — its own width — but `.dev-grip` is absolute at inset-inline-start:0 with translateX(-50%), so 1rem of it sits outside the bar's box and lands back on the page. Live tab (innerWidth 2706, rail 200px): bar 2706-2906 (off screen, correct), grip 2691-2723 (15px on screen, full height). elementFromPoint(innerWidth-2, innerHeight/2) returns .dev-grip.

Impact is worse than a stray cursor: grip.js calls setPointerCapture on pointerdown, so a click landing in that strip routes the entire gesture to the closed rail — the page never sees the drag at all. Also contradicts the readme's own decision, 'No handle when closed.'

Fix: `--dev-grip: 2rem` joins `--dev-rail` on :root (devbar.css), the hide becomes translateX(calc(100% + var(--dev-grip))), and grip.css consumes the token instead of a hard 2rem. Token rather than a literal in the transform because the two files HAVE to agree — that agreement is what broke. Clearing the full grip width rather than the half that protrudes costs nothing off screen and survives sub-pixel rounding.

Verified in the live tab at innerWidth 3440. Closed: grip left 3457 vs 3440 = 0px on screen, 17px clearance; elementFromPoint at 1/4/8/16px inset all return page content, not .dev-grip; scrollWidth == innerWidth so no overflow introduced. Open: bar flush 3240-3440, grip straddles the edge and hit-tests, dev-body reachable. Drag: synthetic pointerdown/move/up applied dev-sizing, resized 200->300px live, cleared the class and persisted. Clean on /framework/, /core/View/ and /ext/Panel/; zero console errors on the DevBar page, its docking doc and its Files tab.

Doc trap avoided: first draft of the doc edits linked file docs as /framework/dev/DevBar/docs/file/grip-css/. No such url — ext/doc/overview/urls says doc/file/*.md renders BESIDE THE SOURCE in the Files tab (/framework/dev/DevBar/files/) and gets no page of its own. Those were the only two /docs/file/ links in the whole repo, which is what gave it away. Both rewritten before landing.

files: browser verification via mcp site eval — geometry, hit-testing and a synthetic drag across 5 pages; tab restored to /framework/ and localStorage rail width restored to 200

assign.outcome: **The closed dev rail is fully off screen.** `.dev-bar` hid with `translateX(100%)` — its own width — but `.dev-grip` is centred on that edge, so half of it hung outside the box the percentage measures and landed back on the page: a 15px invisible `ew-resize` column down the full height of EVERY page, which `setPointerCapture` turned from a wrong cursor into a swallowed gesture. Fix is three lines: `--dev-grip: 2rem` joins `--dev-rail` on `:root`, the hide slides `calc(100% + var(--dev-grip))`, and grip.css consumes the token so the two files cannot drift again. Verified at 3440: 0px on screen with 17px clearance, right-edge clicks reach page content, no overflow — and open/slide/hover-pill/drag-resize all still work. Docs updated: doc/file/devbar.css.md, doc/file/grip.css.md, doc/docking.md, and the readme's 'No handle when closed' decision, which this bug had been quietly violating since the rail shipped.
